Theme

Town, shops & places · Money, work & business

bank noun

for money

also banking business, run a banking business, deposit money in the bank, manage a bank, savings bank, banking, run a bank, banker, bank teller

classical

Traupman 164, 173, 276
Liv.

argentāria, argentāriae f.

noun, first declension

The Vatican lexicon agrees.

Other words

  • argentāria pecūliīs asservandīs — savings bank

    also used · modern · Traupman 174

    Literally “a bank for keeping savings”: pecūlium is a person’s own small savings, classically a slave’s or a son’s.

Examples

  • pecūniam in argentāriā dēpōnere

    to deposit money in the bankTraupman 164

  • argentāriam facere

    to run a banking businessTraupman 276

  • argentāriam moderārī

    to manage a bankTraupman 276

See also bank account, money-changer, cash.
